structured.answer: I couldn't get my own numbers. The "עצמאים" button didn't work, so the calculator stayed on "שכירים" (300 ₪ a month from me plus 900 ₪ from an employer). For that case it shows about 52,334 ₪ in hand after 4 years (10,661 ₪ tax) and 137,649 ₪ after 8 years (no tax). Since I have no employer, my real amounts would be a lot lower.
